function add(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a + b;
}

function classify(n: number): string {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  } else if (n === 0) {
    return "zero";
  } else {
    return "positive";
  }
}

function loopSum(items: number[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (items[i] % 2 === 0) {
      total += items[i];
    }
  }
  let j = 0;
  while (j < items.length) {
    total += 1;
    j++;
  }
  return total;
}

function describe(kind: string): string {
  switch (kind) {
    case "a":
      return "alpha";
    case "b":
      return "beta";
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

function safeDivide(a: number, b: number): number {
  if (a && b) {
    return a / b;
  }
  return 0;
}

function pick(flag: boolean, x: number, y: number): number {
  return flag ? x : y;
}

function tryCatch(): number {
  try {
    return 1;
  } catch (e) {
    return 0;
  }
}

function elseifKeyword(n: number): string {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  } elseif (n === 0) {
    return "zero";
  }
  return "positive";
}
